```{=html}
<div class="tm-anim" id="tmAnim">

  <style>

    .tm-anim {
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, sans-serif;
    border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e2e2e2);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 1rem 1rem .8rem;
    margin: 1rem 0 1.6rem;
    --halo: #ffffff;
    }

    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
        .tm-anim {
            --halo: #131313;
        }
    }

    .tm-anim svg {
        display: block;
        margin: 0 auto;
        max-width: 100%;
        height: auto;
    }

    .tm-anim text {
        fill: var(--fg, #1a1a1a);
        font-size: 11.5px;
        font-family: "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
        paint-order: stroke;
        stroke: var(--halo);
        stroke-width: 4px;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
    }

    .tm-anim .edge {
        stroke: var(--rule, #d0d0d0);
        stroke-width: 1.6;
        fill: none;
    }

    .tm-anim .edge.on {
        stroke: var(--accent, #8a4b2a);
        stroke-width: 3;
    }

    .tm-anim .node circle {
        stroke: var(--halo);
        stroke-width: 2;
        cursor: pointer;
    }

    .tm-anim .node.sel circle {
        stroke: var(--fg, #1a1a1a);
        stroke-width: 2.5;
    }

    .tm-anim .node.lca circle {
        stroke: var(--accent, #8a4b2a);
        stroke-width: 3;
    }

    .tm-anim .node text {
        pointer-events: none;
    }

    .tm-anim .readout {
        margin-top: .9rem;
        padding-top: .7rem;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e2e2e2);
    }

    .tm-anim .stats {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: .5rem;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .tm-anim .stat {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: .4rem;
        padding: .3rem .6rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e2e2e2);
        border-radius: 999px;
        font-size: .8rem;
    }

    .tm-anim .stat .tag {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        min-width: 1.4em;
        padding: .05rem .35rem;
        border-radius: 999px;
        font-family: "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
        font-size: .72rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #fff;
        background: var(--muted, #999);
    }

    .tm-anim .stat .tag.lca {
        background: var(--accent, #8a4b2a);
    }

    .tm-anim .stat .val {
        font-family: "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
        color: var(--fg, #1a1a1a);
    }

    .tm-anim .stat .depth {
        color: var(--muted, #666);
    }

    .tm-anim .eqbox {
        text-align: center;
        margin-top: .6rem;
        font-family: "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
        font-size: .9rem;
        color: var(--fg, #1a1a1a);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    .tm-anim .hint {
        text-align: center;
        font-size: .75rem;
        color: var(--muted, #666);
        margin-top: .35rem;
    }
  </style>

  <svg viewBox="0 0 560 340" width="560" role="img"
       aria-label="a syntax tree; select two nodes to see the path between them">
    <g id="tmEdges"></g><g id="tmNodes"></g>
  </svg>

  <div class="readout" id="tmOut"></div>
  <div class="hint">click a node to move the first marker, click another for the second</div>

  <script>
    (function () {
    var root = document.getElementById("tmAnim");
    var SVG = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

    var N = [
        ["mod", "module", 0, 280, 28, null],
        ["cls", "class Vec", 1, 280, 96, "mod"],
        ["ini", "__init__", 2, 148, 164, "cls"],
        ["sx", "self.x = x", 3, 78, 232, "ini"],
        ["sy", "self.y = y", 3, 212, 232, "ini"],
        ["nrm", "norm", 2, 408, 164, "cls"],
        ["t0", "t = 0", 3, 318, 232, "nrm"],
        ["for", "for c in self", 3, 424, 232, "nrm"],
        ["acc", "t += c*c", 4, 424, 300, "for"],
        ["ret", "return", 3, 516, 232, "nrm"]
    ];
    var by = {};
    N.forEach(function (n) {
        by[n[0]] = {
            id: n[0], label: n[1], depth: n[2],
            x: n[3], y: n[4], parent: n[5]
        };
    });

    var gE = document.getElementById("tmEdges"), gN = document.getElementById("tmNodes");
    var edgeEl = {};

    N.forEach(function (n) {
        var v = by[n[0]];
        if (v.parent) {
            var p = by[v.parent];
            var e = document.createElementNS(SVG, "line");
            e.setAttribute("x1", p.x); e.setAttribute("y1", p.y + 8);
            e.setAttribute("x2", v.x); e.setAttribute("y2", v.y - 8);
            e.setAttribute("class", "edge");
            gE.appendChild(e); edgeEl[v.id] = e;
        }
        var g = document.createElementNS(SVG, "g");
        g.setAttribute("class", "node"); g.setAttribute("data-id", v.id);
        var c = document.createElementNS(SVG, "circle");
        c.setAttribute("cx", v.x); c.setAttribute("cy", v.y); c.setAttribute("r", 9);
        c.setAttribute("fill", "var(--muted, #999)");
        var t = document.createElementNS(SVG, "text");
        t.setAttribute("x", v.x); t.setAttribute("y", v.y + 21);
        t.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
        t.textContent = v.label;
        g.appendChild(c); g.appendChild(t);
        gN.appendChild(g);
        g.addEventListener("click", function () { pick(v.id); });
    });

    function chain(id) {
        var out = [];
        while (id) { out.push(id); id = by[id].parent; }
        return out;
    }
    function lcaOf(a, b) {
        var A = chain(a), inA = {};
        A.forEach(function (x) { inA[x] = 1; });
        var c = b;
        while (c && !inA[c]) c = by[c].parent;
        return c;
    }

    var A = "sx", B = "acc", next = 0;
    function pick(id) {
        if (next === 0) { A = id; next = 1; } else { B = id; next = 0; }
        draw();
    }

    function draw() {
        var L = lcaOf(A, B);
        var on = {};
        var c = A; while (c && c !== L) { on[c] = 1; c = by[c].parent; }
        c = B; while (c && c !== L) { on[c] = 1; c = by[c].parent; }

        Object.keys(edgeEl).forEach(function (k) {
            edgeEl[k].setAttribute("class", on[k] ? "edge on" : "edge");
        });
        root.querySelectorAll(".node").forEach(function (g) {
            var id = g.getAttribute("data-id");
            g.setAttribute("class", "node" + (id === L ? " lca" : "") +
                (id === A || id === B ? " sel" : ""));
            var fill = "var(--muted, #999)";
            if (id === A || id === B) fill = "var(--accent, #8a4b2a)";
            else if (id === L) fill = "var(--fg, #1a1a1a)";
            else if (on[id]) fill = "var(--fg, #666)";
            g.querySelector("circle").setAttribute("fill", fill);
        });

        var da = by[A].depth, db = by[B].depth, dl = by[L].depth;
        var d = da + db - 2 * dl;
        document.getElementById("tmOut").innerHTML =
            "<div class='stats'>" +
                "<div class='stat'><span class='tag'>a</span><span class='val'>" + by[A].label + "</span><span class='depth'>depth " + da + "</span></div>" +
                "<div class='stat'><span class='tag'>b</span><span class='val'>" + by[B].label + "</span><span class='depth'>depth " + db + "</span></div>" +
                "<div class='stat'><span class='tag lca'>lca</span><span class='val'>" + by[L].label + "</span><span class='depth'>depth " + dl + "</span></div>" +
            "</div>" +
            "<div class='eqbox'>d<sub>T</sub>(a,b) = " + da + " + " + db + " &minus; 2&middot;" + dl + " = <b>" + d + "</b> edges</div>";
    }
    draw();
    })();
  </script>

</div>
```
